symptomShortText: Cracks at retainer flange radius formed on TOOL1 - worn draw punch insert

causesIshikawa.description: Press operator ran TOOL1 at the released stroke rate
WC-PRESS-09-TOOL1 draw punch insert worn after 410k strokes - radius 0.6mm vs 1.0-1.2mm, material over-thinned at the flange
Lubrication and stroke rate per DOC-8840 Rev C
Coil COIL-6705 hardness 148 HV, elongation 26% - within specification

fiveWhyChain.question: Why did the retainers crack at the flange radius?
fiveWhyChain.answer: Wall thinning at the radius reached 23% against max 15%, beyond what the steel can stretch

fiveWhyChain.question: Why did TOOL1 over-thin the flange radius?
fiveWhyChain.answer: The draw punch radius had worn down to 0.6mm, concentrating strain at the radius

fiveWhyChain.question: Why was the worn insert still in the tool? (root cause)
fiveWhyChain.answer: Punch inserts had no stroke count limit in SAP PM and were changed only after breakage

actions.actionText: Quarantine all SR8 retainers from batch B-53720 and 100% visual crack check under magnification
Replace the worn draw punch insert on WC-PRESS-09 tool 1 station 3 and verify the 1.1mm radius
Add a stroke count limit for draw punch inserts to the preventive maintenance schedule in SAP PM

fmeaLink.description: Flange radius cracking from worn draw punch insert

lessonsLearned.whatWorked: Measuring wall thinning per tool pointed at TOOL1 instead of the coil
lessonsLearned.whatDidnt: Inserts were run to failure - no stroke-based replacement

isIsNot.isWhereWhenItHappens: SR8 flange radius - WC-PRESS-09-TOOL1 station 3 - batch B-53720, August 2026
isIsNot.notes: Defect follows the tool, not the coil
